prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+7.8% vs -6.3%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 3 winning tests (+8.1%, +4.1%, and +4.6%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 3 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: -2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.2% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split View Pet Selection and Trait Selector: Transform the pick_friend screen into a split view layout combining pet animated previews with interactive personality trait tags. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate across the funnel at 60.9% with a high mean completion time of 1017s.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet System Compatibility Status Banner: Display a dynamic diagnostic status ticker on the waiting screen confirming rendering engine readiness and desktop overlay hookup. (why: Support logs show 3 emails regarding pets not rendering on desktop or the app failing to open properly during initial launch.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Companion Quick Control Cheat Sheet Screen: Insert a new screen after home intro showing essential keyboard shortcuts and tray icon commands for managing the desktop pet. (why: Support received 3 emails post-onboarding asking how to hide, direct, or interact with the pet on the desktop.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Intro Visual Split Cards: Redesign the initial story screen into a split layout presenting companion capabilities alongside mascot artwork. (why: Choose path has a large gap between median time (8s) and mean time (514s), indicating early context confusion.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Persistence Security Hint: Add an explicit hint to the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores saved companions and pet progress. (why: The single largest support issue (8 emails) involved users losing pets or seeing resets after signing back into their account.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Adoption Summary Confirmation Stage: Add a new summary screen right before adoption certificate generation that reviews pet attributes and custom name choices. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or wrong output, while adoption step overall retains only 60.9% of users.)
6: [home, notification] Background Generation Readiness Alert Sound: Add an audio finish cue and notification toggle to the waiting screen when asset generation finishes. (why: Home waiting screen has a 201s median and 2336s mean time, showing users tab away during wait times and lose track of completion.)
7: [finish, new_flow] First Desktop Orientation Task Checklist: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist layout guiding users through initial pet interaction steps. (why: Post-onboarding complaints show 4 bug reports on feature misbehavior and 3 emails regarding control confusion.)
8: [sign_in, incentive] Signed-In Companion Cloud Backup Badge: Display an active Cloud Storage Protection badge on the sign-in screen highlighting account safety. (why: 8 support emails complained about lost pets and reset accounts upon re-authenticating.)

scores.note: Targets the biggest funnel bottleneck (60.9% conversion), though past redesign evidence remains thin.
Addresses 3 support emails and long home step completion times with non-intrusive status info.
Adding new screens to finish historically yields negative or mixed results despite post-onboarding support emails.
Addresses large time gap on choose_path, though evidence for choose_path redesigns is still limited.
Solves top support complaint (8 emails) on sign_in step, which has strong historical test success.
Adding a new screen to adoption is proven to decrease conversion (-2.0%) despite fixing user setup issues.
Directly targets extreme completion time variance (201s vs 2336s) caused by background waiting.
Supported by 7 total user complaints, but new flow changes carry high implementation cost and friction risk.
Complements sign_in success pattern while directly alleviating the #1 support issue via simple UI badge.
